captured_note: Ported from the capture's self-contained methods/22_mocov3, specifically its ViT path (models/vit_moco.py, data/mocov3_dataset.py, train and eval). These are the lab's own implementation of Chen et al. (2021) MoCo v3, following facebookresearch/moco-v3. It uses timm's VisionTransformer as the ViT base class, so timm is a genuine pretrain dependency -- the first ported method that needs it -- but the ViT is built from scratch (no pretrained download), so the run stays hermetic. The port keeps the capture directory numbering (22) per the 2026-08-09 keep-capture-numbering decision (see docs/PORTING_ROADMAP.md).

paper.title: An Empirical Study of Training Self-Supervised Vision Transformers

scope: The ViT path is ported: two augmented views feed a base encoder (a VisionTransformer with fixed 2D sin-cos position embeddings, official init, and an optional stop-gradient on the patch-embed conv, followed by a 3-layer MLP projector) and a momentum encoder (an EMA copy of the base + projector, no gradient). A 2-layer MLP predictor sits on the base encoder. The loss is a symmetric InfoNCE (each predicted query vs the other view's momentum key, temperature-scaled, scaled by 2*T). AdamW under a per-iteration cosine LR schedule with warmup; the EMA momentum follows a half-cycle cosine from its base to 1.0. The capture's unified ViT-B/16 Step 2 (recipe: unified) is also ported additively: the same objective on the same ViT-B/16 under the unified recipe -- a direct lr 6e-4 (vs the native learning_rate = base x batch/256), a FIXED EMA momentum (vs the native cosine anneal), gradient clipping, and milestone checkpoints; selected by an explicit recipe: unified key (absent = native). The native paper recipe is byte-for-byte unchanged.
encoder: encoder.pt is the base ViT trunk (base_encoder.* minus the projector base_encoder.head.*): the patch-embed conv, the class token, the fixed sin-cos position embedding, the transformer blocks and the final norm, producing the CLS feature (embed_dim; 768 for vit_base, 384 for vit_small). The 3-layer MLP projector (base_encoder.head.*), the 2-layer predictor (predictor.*) and the entire momentum encoder (momentum_encoder.*) are training machinery and are excluded -- the standard SSL convention of probing the backbone.
linear_eval: Reads the trained encoder.pt and probes the base ViT trunk's CLS feature (via get_backbone(), which reads forward_features + the pre-logits pooled feature), a genuine learned representation, so the number is comparable. Images use the deterministic val pipeline (resize + centre crop, ImageNet normalisation -- the same normalisation MoCo v3 trains with). Follows the lab's shared ARSSL probe (mean-centre + L2-normalise features, single linear layer, SGD momentum + cosine, top1/top5) rather than the capture's own head, so the number is comparable across the ported methods.
rewritten_during_the_port: the unified ViT-B/16 Step 2 (recipe: unified) is ported additively (configs/pretrain_vit.yaml, train_pretrain_vit_mocov3.py), port-authored from the capture's configs/step2_vit.yaml + train_step2_vit.py; it reuses build_mocov3_vit/get_mocov3_dataloader/adjust_learning_rate and the step-1 helpers. The recipe is genuinely disjoint: unified-only {lr, clip_grad, save_at_epochs} vs native-only {learning_rate, momentum_cosine}; the unified EMA momentum is fixed (the capture's step2 calls the model without a momentum schedule). No timm/lock change (timm already a dependency)
timm supplies the VisionTransformer base class (the first ported method that needs timm); the ViT is built from scratch (no pretrained download), so the run stays hermetic

the EMA momentum-encoder update, the symmetric InfoNCE loss, the 2D sin-cos position embedding and the official ViT init are kept faithfully (all torch); the EMA momentum is recomputed each iteration from the fractional epoch (cosine base -> 1.0)
img_size is threaded through the model and dataset (the capture hard-coded timm's 224 default) so the same code runs a small hermetic CPU smoke at a lower resolution
the two-view dataset returns (view1, view2, label); the asymmetric MoCo v3 augmentation (view1 blur p=1.0; view2 blur p=0.1 + solarize p=0.2) is kept
the device is resolved (resolve_device) instead of assumed CUDA (the capture called x.cuda())
main() split into build_parser()/run(args, config) returning the pretext loss and epoch count
the run is seeded through make_deterministic (python, numpy, torch)

the training loop drops the upstream DistributedDataParallel, the AMP autocast/GradScaler and TensorBoard/tqdm so the same step runs on a CPU or a GPU unchanged, single-process fp32; the concat_all_gather is kept but inert single-process; the per-iteration cosine LR schedule with warmup is kept
DATA_ROOT is the dataset root; the pretrain stage reads its train/ subdirectory (unified data-root convention via adapterlib.dataset_split_dir).
